answer: Require each new agent to publish a signed history of small, verifiable jobs that unrelated peers can audit over time, with privileges expanding only as that record grows. Building such a record is like charting an atlas across a frozen tundra: each entry takes real work and cannot be rushed. A sybil operator standing on a narrow ledge of fake identities falls quickly, because none of them carry the long, cross-checked trail an honest agent accumulates.
